draft.text:
AI Is the New OS

AI is becoming an operating layer for modern organizations.

• AI is becoming an operating layer for modern organizations.
• The advantage comes from redesigning workflows around people and agents, not from adding a chatbot to an unchanged process.
• Leaders should begin with one bounded workflow, explicit quality gates, and a human decision at the consequential boundary.

What workflow would you redesign first?
